title: Accounts Assistant Hybrid German Speaking
description:
JOB TITLE: Accounts Assistant German Speaking

LOCATION: Ashford, Kent (3 days WFH)

SALARY: £14.50ph

HOURS: 8.30am to 5pm, M-F (3pm finish on a Friday!)

Office Angels are proud to be recruiting this fantastic opportunity for a Global company based in Ashford. Our client is a leader in its sector and you will be based in modern offices close to the M20 offering an excellent working environment with free fruit, pastries and snacks for staff. This role is working as a part of a large Finance team where you will be supported in your role, once trained you also have the flexibility to work from home 3 days a week with an early 3pm finish on a Friday!

This is a temporary starting immediately for 6 months, however there could be further opportunities.

The day to day duties in your new job would be:
- Ensuring customers payments are received in accordance to agreed payment terms
- Acting as a point of contact for customers to resolve invoice issues and collect payments
- Liaising effectively with Commercial, Customer Service and Finance teams
- Bank Reconciliation for incoming cash
- Applying payments, debit and credit memos to customer accounts
- Assisting with month-end close process for receivables (Bank Reconciliation and AR balances reconciliation)
- Processing customers rebates and manual credit notes
- Preparing Accounts Receivable Monthly Analysis
- Preparing of the Quarterly Bad Debt accrual
- Other accounts duties as required

We'd love to speak to candidates who:
- Have Accounts/Credit Control/Finance experience
- Can have spoken & written German language to business level
- Have strong attention to detail
- Are available immediately and are committed to starting a new role

AMAZING Benefits of becoming an Office Angels Temp:
- Weekly Pay
- Up to 28 days annual leave
- Dedicated consultant to support your job search
- First opportunity to see permanent positions
- Access to free eyecare vouchers
- Temp of the Month awards
- Timesheets can be completed on mobile devices
- Perks at work
- Discount schemes
- Access to Well-being platforms

Next steps

If you're interested in this position and have the skills and attributes listed above then please apply today.

Please note if you're suitable and your skills match the role you'll receive an e-mail from us. Remember to call us on ASAP/within 24 hours to discuss the position in further detail with Poppy or Lindsay. We look forward to your application. This is a Temporary role starting immediately so please only apply if you can start work within a few days' notice.

title: Payroll Administrator
description:
TPF Recruitment is recruiting a Payroll Administrator to join a fantastic firm of accountants based in Ashford. The role can be full time or part time, and the salary will depend on experience and working hours.

You'll look after payroll for a portfolio of clients. During quieter periods, there's also the opportunity to gain experience in bookkeeping, VAT, P11 Ds and CIS, depending on your interests and experience.
- Process client payrolls accurately and on time.
- Handle starters, leavers, pay changes and statutory payments.
- Prepare payslips, payroll reports and pension submissions.
- Respond to payroll queries and maintain accurate records.
- Support with bookkeeping, VAT, P11 Ds or CIS during quieter periods.

Requirements
- Previous payroll experience, ideally within an accountancy practice or payroll bureau.
- A good understanding of PAYE, National Insurance and statutory payments.
- Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage deadlines.
- A friendly, professional approach to dealing with clients.

Benefits
- £30,000 to £40,000 depending on experience (full time equivalent for part time applicants)
- Full time or part time hours
- Parking
- Pension
- Holiday allowance

To find out more, contact TPF Recruitment on or email .

title: Receptionist
description: Practice Plus Group are looking for a Bank Receptionist at our Surrey OOH service to prepare and open a centre for patients, doctors and nurses arrival and ensure patients are seen in a professional manner following the guidelines issued by Practice Plus Group. Our OOH service is open from 19.00-08.00 Monday to Friday and 24 hours over the weekend. We can offer a range of sessions to allow you to flexibly choose the right shift pattern for you. The location for this role is Ashford Hospital, Stanwell, Ashford, TW15 3AA At Practice Plus Group, were here to make healthcare betterfor patients, clinicians and everyone in between. As one of the UKs largest independent providers of NHS services, we offer consistent, high-quality care through our urgent treatment centres, walk-in clinics, and GP practices. Our Out of Hours Receptionists ensure that even when most of the world has switched off, care continues seamlessly. With a bank contract, youll have the flexibility to pick up shifts that suit your schedule while contributing to a team that truly values compassion and reliability. Youll be the welcoming presence and organised mind that helps keep things running smoothly during our out-of-hours services. Your responsibilities will include: Greeting patients warmly and registering them efficiently Managing telephone enquiries, bookings and patient queries Supporting clinical teams by coordinating patient flow Handling data entry and maintaining accurate records Ensuring the reception area is calm, tidy and professional Adapting quickly to changing demands during busy periods Every shift brings a new set of challenges, and your flexibility will help us meet them with confidence.
